It's one Worker (Hono + React), D1 for app data, and logs go Pipelines → Iceberg in your own R2 bucket → Basin SQL. You get live tail, search, dashboards and alerts with webhooks. npm run setup creates everything in your account.

Things I learned: every Basin SQL query is billed at a 10 MB minimum, which shaped most of the UI (cache everything, refresh only live data). Logs take 30 seconds to 3 minutes to become searchable, so the UI says so instead of pretending to be real time.
